# Site content review and pace-band consolidation — 16 October 2026

## Scope and decision

Screened 124 public HTML files, including the intentionally noindex 404 response. The eight preset pace-band landings add a repeated layer between the goal guides and the same generator. Consolidate those landings and retain the 20 goal-time guides, functional tools and original personal articles. There are 116 public HTML files after consolidation, including 115 canonical content pages.

The review covers page purposes, headings, body text, paragraph overlap, metadata, structured-data syntax, internal destinations/fragments and sitemaps. Deeper comparisons focused on the preset/goal layers, wind, hills, negative splits, late slowdown, combined predictions and the Norwegian cluster. This is a sitewide screening with targeted deeper reviews, not independent replication of every research citation or a visit to every venue. Private account reports are retained separately and are not included in this repository.

## Implemented changes

- Retire the eight `/pace-band/<goal>/` landings. Explicit permanent redirects preserve each exact finish target for slash, non-slash and index.html paths. The historical colon-form 3:15 path is covered too.
- Open the canonical `/printable-pace-band/` generator with that goal, kilometre units and even pacing selected. Sub-four remains 3:59:59. Opening the link does not automatically print.
- Link calculator shortcuts directly to the generator and remove retired entries from both sitemaps.
- Keep the eight downloadable SVG checkpoint cards visible on their matching goal guides. Edited targets continue to use the existing goal-aware generator links.
- Correct the combined predictor's unsupported comparative-accuracy promise and remove two repeated introductory blocks. Its fixed-weight calculation is unchanged.
- Remove introductory promises that late slowing is individually predictable/preventable or that a tailwind will recover lost time. Replace the repeated after-30K universal-cause quick answer with evidence-review links. Preserve historical anchors and research references.
- Add readiness/browser regression coverage for exact restored goals, permanent redirects, direct links, canonical identity and visible card downloads.

## Remaining editorial priorities

| Pair or group | Finding | Recommended next treatment |
|---|---|---|
| `/even-vs-negative-splits/` and `/blog/negative-split-pacing/` | Same four-hour half-split table, definitions and strong-finish example. | One main split-strategy guide, or a genuinely different interactive comparison task. |
| `/adjust-marathon-pace/wind/` and `/blog/wind-pacing-headwind-tailwind/` | Both cover headwind effort, shelter and catch-up decisions. | Combine the practical route checklist with the relative-air-speed example if distinct tasks cannot be demonstrated. |
| `/adjust-marathon-pace/hills/` and the hill-pacing blog article | Both cover climbs, controlled descents, downhill loading and preparation. | One stronger hill guide can retain the useful research references. |
| Late-race-slowdown module and after-30K article | Both organise possible causes, split review and race responses. | Separate measurement from a documented personal case, or merge the generic review material. |
| Norwegian overview, source-context page and FAQ | Several related URLs; other pages do provide distinct calendar/work-duration examples. | Review fragmentation after the stronger overlapping pairs; shared references alone are not grounds for deletion. |
| Melbourne hub and 18 venue guides | Specific local access, route, facilities and source information. | Keep; add real visit observations/photos and maintain source dates before expanding further. |

The highest-value original addition is a documented pace-band print/use check with actual settings, measurements, legibility observations and genuine photos. No field test or visit is invented by this release. Short legal/contact pages and useful charts need no padding to meet a word-count target. Consolidation cannot guarantee AdSense approval, and no review application or ad activation is part of this release.

## Verification and maintenance

The local calculation, goal-contract, link, sitemap/canonical, preset-parameter, consent, affiliate and Melbourne checks passed before publication. The PR workflow must also run the actual browser interactions, 320/390 px layouts, PDF checks and all-page scan. Verify redirects against Cloudflare's deployed engine before release; the local HTTP emulation alone does not establish production behavior. See PR checks for the final results.

The generator remains canonical for its query-string configurations. Do not recreate retired landings when rebuilding assets. Preserve existing saved/share URLs and the exact sub-four seconds. Keep raw account exports and private assessment metrics outside the public repository.

## References

- [Google: pages ready for AdSense](https://support.google.com/adsense/answer/7299563?hl=en).
- [Google Publisher Policies: low-value content](https://support.google.com/publisherpolicies/answer/11112688?hl=en).
- [Google Search Central: permanent redirects](https://developers.google.com/search/docs/crawling-indexing/301-redirects).
- [Cloudflare Pages: redirects](https://developers.cloudflare.com/pages/configuration/redirects/).
